description: Reference / metadata for the PIP dataset. table="versions" lists available data releases & PPP rounds; table="aux_list" lists all auxiliary tables; any other value (e.g. "countries", "regions", "poverty_lines", "indicators", "dictionary") returns that auxiliary table. Use to look up valid country codes, region mappings, or supported indicators.

table.description: "versions", "aux_list", or an auxiliary table name like "countries" | "regions" | "poverty_lines" | "indicators" | "dictionary". Default "versions".

name: list_reference
